title: RNAseq of Tregs before and after treatment with Multipep
description: Intent: to investigate whether treatment of an individual with peptide immunotherapy using MultiPepT1De results in a change in the transcriptional profile of CD4+ regulatory T cells.  Regulatory T cells (CD4+ CD25+ CD127lo) were isolated by flow cytometry cell sorting from cryopreserved PBMC from subjects before and after treatment with MultiPepT1De. RNA was extracted using the AllPrep micro kit (Qiagen) and RNAseq libraries prepared from extracted RNA (91-140 ng)

samples.title: Sample 12
samples.description: Protocols: Cryopreserved PBMC samples (10^6 cells) from baseline (1 or 2 weeks before first treatment) and 24 weeks post treatment timepoint were thawed from 10 subjects and stained first using live/dead violet then surface stained using CD14 CD3 CD4 CD25 CD127 antibodies. A minimum of 40,000 CD14- CD3+ CD4+ CD25+ CD127lo Tregs (average = 81,600, max = 158,300) were sorted using BD FACSAria III and frozen at -80C in minimal PBS prior to DNA/RNA extraction. DNA/RNA was extracted in parallel with the AllPrep micro kit (Qiagen) RNAseq libraries prepared from 2/3 of extracted RNA (91-140 ng) with SMART-Seq v4 and NuGen Ovation Ultralow
attributes: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
